prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Customize Pet Personality", "Select your pet's activity level and sound style before bringing them home.", "Save Personality", "Energy Level", "Vocal Style"]
1: ["Choose Desktop Habitat", "Pick a cozy resting mat style for your pet's primary desktop spot.", "Confirm Habitat", "Mat Design"]
2: ["Sign In to Protect Your Pet", "Connect your account to automatically save your pet progress and desktop settings.", "Cloud Sync Sign In", "Automatic Cloud Backup Enabled"]
3: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Use the tray icon or right-click your pet anytime to hide, summon, or open settings.", "Right-click pet anytime for main menu"]
4: ["Tip: Click the system tray icon anytime to show or hide your pet.", "Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+P"]
5: ["Signing in links your pet ID so your pet state is preserved across app updates.", "Cloud Pet Recovery Active"]
6: ["Choose Your Pet Creation Path", "Select a pre-made companion or design a custom pet in 2 easy steps.", "Start Now"]
7: ["Preparing Your Desktop Pet...", "Compiling animations and preparing desktop overlay engine.", "Setting up desktop overlay..."]
8: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your pet is officially registered! Click below to spawn them onto your desktop.", "Place Pet on Desktop"]
9: ["Pet is active and exploring your screen!"]
